statements.text: It adds no role, landmark or box; put landmarks and headings inside it as usual.
high-contrast is a black-on-white preset you choose; nothing follows the OS contrast or color-scheme setting, and it sets no color-scheme, so native controls stay light under dark.

summary: Scope element that applies a Violet theme preset (light, dark, high-contrast) to its subtree, such as a dark panel in a light page.

usage.text: preset is light, dark or high-contrast; any other or missing value falls back to light. Changing the attribute restyles the subtree at once.
Connecting it installs the theme stylesheet into its document, or into the shadow root it sits in, so a scoped preset needs no separate installVioletTheme() call.
The host is display: contents and paints nothing: give a child background var(--color-surface-page) and color var(--color-text-primary), or a dark subtree shows the light page behind it.
Token custom properties set on it, such as --color-action-primary-background, override that token for its subtree only.
